C1844.title: Wu Credit Card Fraud Case: Cashing-Out Form of Card Fraud Classified
C1844.summary: In March 2021, defendant Wu joined a hotel in Jiexiu, Shanxi. The hotel head Yue provided Wu with a phone registered to a WeChat account bound to Yue's credit card for Douyin livestream tipping and shared the payment password. In July 2021, Wu used the card without permission to recharge 200 yuan to his own phone, then contacted cash-out agents via WeChat and clicked cash-out links to drain card funds. In June 2025, People's Court Daily published the case as a reference case, clarifying the classification of cashing-out forms of credit card theft.
